references.text: Ziklag is also mentioned as a city in the inheritance of Judah, which shows an overlap between the territories of Judah and Simeon
Ziklag was given to David by the Philistine king Achish and remained a city under the kings of Judah
The Amalekites attacked and burned Ziklag, the city mentioned in this verse
Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, and Hazar-Susah are again listed as cities belonging to the tribe of Simeon in Chronicles
Ziklag is mentioned as a city where descendants of Judah lived after the exile
